        .fc .fc-day-today {

    /* Estilos específicos para móviles - Vista Lista */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            #calendar {
                padding: 10px !important;
                border-radius: 12px !important;
            }

            .fc .fc-toolbar-title {
                font-size: 1.1rem !important;

            .fc .fc-button {
                font-size: 0.75rem !important;
                padding: 6px 12px !important;

            /* Toolbar compacto */
            .fc .fc-toolbar {
                margin-bottom: 12px !important;
                flex-wrap: wrap !important;
                gap: 8px !important;
            }

            .fc .fc-toolbar-chunk {
                margin-bottom: 4px !important;
            }

            /* Ocultar botones de vista en móvil */
            .fc .fc-dayGridMonth-button,
            .fc .fc-timeGridWeek-button,
            .fc .fc-timeGridDay-button {
                display: none !important;
            }

            /* ===== VISTA LISTA - estilos ===== */
            .fc-list {
                border: none !important;
            }

            .fc-list-day-cushion {
                background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eff6ff, #dbeafe) !important;

                border-radius: 10px !important;
                margin-bottom: 4px !important;
            }

            .fc-list-day-text,

                font-weight: 700 !important;

            .fc-list-day.fc-day.fc-day-today .fc-list-day-cushion.fc-cell-shaded {
                background: #c4e46d !important;
                background-color: #c4e46d !important;
                border: none !important;
                box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(196, 228, 109, 0.3) !important;
                position: relative !important;

                transform: scale(1.01) !important;

            .fc-list-day.fc-day.fc-day-today .fc-list-day-text,
            .fc-list-day.fc-day.fc-day-today .fc-list-day-side-text {
                color: #2563eb !important;
                font-weight: 700 !important;
                font-size: 0.95rem !important;
                text-shadow: none !important;
            }

            
            
            .fc-list-event {
                border-radius: 10px !important;
                margin-bottom: 6px !important;

            }

            .fc-list-event-dot {

            }

                color: #64748b !important;
                white-space: nowrap !important;

            .fc-list-event-title a {
                font-size: 0.95rem !important;
                font-weight: 700 !important;
                color: #1e293b !important;
                text-decoration: none !important;
            }

            .fc-list-empty {
                background: white !important;

            .fc-list-empty-cushion {
                font-size: 0.9rem !important;

            .fc-scrollgrid {

        @media (max-width: 1024px) and (min-width: 769px) {
            .fc-event {

                padding: 3px 7px !important;
            }
